title: Only `listen`, `socket_mode` and `workers` in `[server]` need a restart, `listen` is one flat array defaulting to `127.0.0.1:8000` in both modes, and the flag is the last word
divergesFromPhp: `listen` is the origin's own address rather than a php-fpm pool's, and `workers` counts accept cores rather than sizing a `pm.*` process pool
